_readme: Copy this file to known_connections.json (which is gitignored) and fill
in real people you actually know — this is the ONLY source for Priority
A (1st-degree connections) and Priority B (university alumni) contacts.
We never scrape or log into LinkedIn to discover these automatically.
Top-level keys are company names, lowercased. Each entry needs:
linkedin_url   - link to their LinkedIn profile
is_first_degree - true if you're already connected on LinkedIn
university     - fill in if they share your school (leave '' if not),
matched against config.py's PROFILE university fields
department     - optional, shown in the Telegram alert for context
Keys starting with an underscore (like this one) are ignored by the loader.
